issue.title: [Nokia][supervisor]The asic_type of Nokia platform IXR7250E supervisor card should be broadcom-dnx

failure.body:
#### Description
The asic_type of Nokia platform IXR7250E supervisor card should be broadcom-dnx instead of broadcom

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1.  Open the device data file /usr/share/sonic/device/x86_64-nokia_ixr7250e_sup-r0/platform_asic file.  It contains "broadcom"

#### Describe the results you received:
File platform_asic contains "broadcom" instead of "broadcom-dnx"

#### Describe the results you expected:
File platform_asic should contain "broadcom-dnx"

resolution.description:
#### Why I did it
The  Nokia  IXR7250E supervisor card asic_type should be broadcom-dnx instead of broadcom. Fixes #9140
#### How I did it
Changed the "broadcom" to "broadcom-dnx" in the device/nokia/x86_64-nokia_ixr7250e_sup-r0/platform_asic file

#### How to verify it
Edit the file device/nokia/x86_64-nokia_ixr7250e_sup-r0/platform_asic on platform to verify it
